scope: Local deterministic fixtures, build and packaging; no installed-host acceptance.

comparison.selection: Complete current worktree, preserving existing uncommitted changes; CI uses the same HEAD merge base.

verification.coverage: 26 browser fixtures; Go race tests and vet; frontend types/build; 201 specification and 20 legacy tooling tests; packaging, six installer cases, connection/browser-controller fixtures and compiled daemon/MCP/stdio smoke.

browser_assertions: Saved override initializes by item including P0; every priority and automatic saves immediately; rejection restores previous value with inline feedback.
Relationship drafts remain by item across item/tab changes; message drafts remain by run across selection/tab changes while the app stays open.
Open agent chooses newest retained run excluding prepared/cleaned records; New run remains available.
Default launch enters immutable prepared review with mode/policy; newest draft reopens without another preparation or implicit Start.
Assembled daemon lost Start response locates its accepted run with read_run; unknown status disables Start/Edit; confirmed prepared status permits explicit same-ID retry.
Global attention displays owning title/profile, selects that run and returns focus/conversation after answer.
Readable accept/session/deny/cancel/amendment and requested-permission labels submit unchanged payloads; actual approval/review/editor rectangles fit both 390px themes.
Repository form shows local Saving/error with retained values; first success returns to Inbox; profile/mode/skill/discovery feedback and diagnostics remain available; Jira controls stay disabled.
Command output and workspace details collapse while plans, changes and failures stay visible; dirty cleanup/explicit Resume preserve retained work.
Empty searches offer No matching items/Clear filters; zero-attention shortcut is hidden.
hosting_assertions: Valid observed remote registration promotes browser artifact; missing/invalid mapping leads with OAuth connection steps; portable artifacts and manifests remain collapsed.
remaining_limits: New build is not installed or observed in the signed-in Work host. Earlier installed-version evidence retains its original scope.
Ordinary relationship/message drafts end on app reload/close; prepared launches and conversation history remain durable.
Fixtures do not establish real-host subscriptions/callbacks, login, new-build soak, full manual contrast, screen-reader or accessibility acceptance.
Independent-client concurrent Starts, other approval/schema/secret-field variants and enabled Jira UI behavior remain explicit specification gaps.
